failure_cases.must_fail_when: The packet says exact p2-75 approval has been collected.
The packet allows executor writes now.
The packet reports any old-file write.
The packet claims the full goal is complete.
The packet omits the exact-approval plus fresh-prewrite stop rule.
The packet implies merge, promotion, reviewed knowledge, evidence support, or action basis.
The packet omits the p2-88 decision packet as the user-facing decision surface.
